narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of "Pairs of Linear Equations in Two Variables." In this chapter, we'll explore how to represent real-life situations using two equations and find solutions that satisfy both conditions. Get ready to build a strong foundation for advanced mathematical concepts!
